bibliographic.title: Energy-aware field sensing and scheduled agronomic advice

publication.abstract: A solar-powered field sensor lengthens its sampling interval when the state of charge of its battery falls below a threshold, and returns to the normal interval once charged. Agronomic advice is delivered to the farmer only within a time window the farmer selects. The sensor's calibration offset is updated by exponential smoothing each time a reference reading is available.

claims.claim: A solar-powered field sensor that increases its sampling interval when its battery state of charge is below a threshold.
A method of delivering agronomic advice only within a delivery window selected by the farmer.
